name: New.zeros_on_line
summary: Trichotomy for Re s against 1/2; right of 1/2 by hypothesis, left of it by the symmetry of zeros.

steps.claim: Let N ≠ 0 (instance), χ a Dirichlet character modulo N, and s with 0 < Re s < 1 and L(s, χ) = 0. If Re s > 1/2, h gives L(s, χ) ≠ 0 (s ≠ 1 as Re s < 1), impossible. If Re s < 1/2, the symmetry of zeros (`LFunction_one_sub_eq_zero`, applicable as Re s ≠ 0 and s ≠ 1) gives: the gamma factor of χ vanishes at s, impossible because it is Γ_ℝ(s) or Γ_ℝ(s + 1) and Γ_ℝ has no zero on Re > 0; or L(1 − s, χ⁻¹) = 0, which h excludes as Re(1 − s) > 1/2 and 1 − s ≠ 1. Hence Re s = 1/2.
steps.lean:
fun N _ ↦ by grind [h N, Complex.one_re, Complex.sub_re, → LFunction_one_sub_eq_zero,
  Complex.ext_iff, DirichletCharacter.gammaFactor, Complex.Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos]
